  conv_rhs => rw [← Int.emod_add_ediv j (period g a), zpow_add, mul_smul,

theorem mul_smul (b b' : B) (x : X') : (b * b') • x = b • b' • x :=
  match x with

    simp only [leftCoset_assoc]

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.ETransform
/-- The **Dyson e-transform**. Turns `(s, t)` into `(s ∪ e • t, t ∩ e⁻¹ • s)`. This reduces the
product of the two sets. -/
@[to_additive (attr := simps) "The **Dyson e-transform**.
Turns `(s, t)` into `(s ∪ e +ᵥ t, t ∩ -e +ᵥ s)`. This reduces the sum of the two sets."]
def mulDysonETransform : Finset α × Finset α :=
  (x.1 ∪ e • x.2, x.2 ∩ e⁻¹ • x.1)

--src: Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Fin
theorem finRotate_succ_eq_decomposeFin {n : ℕ} :
    finRotate n.succ = decomposeFin.symm (1, finRotate n) := by
  ext i
  cases n; · simp
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · simp
  rw [coe_finRotate, decomposeFin_symm_apply_succ, if_congr i.succ_eq_last_succ rfl rfl]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · rw [Fin.val_succ, Function.Injective.map_swap Fin.val_injective, Fin.val_succ, coe_finRotate,
      if_neg h, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one,
      swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Nat.succ_ne_zero _) (Nat.succ_succ_ne_one _)]

--src: Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Basic
theorem Function.Injective.map_swap [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (x y z : α) :
    f (Equiv.swap x y z) = Equiv.swap (f x) (f y) (f z) := by
  conv_rhs => rw [Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  · rw [hf h₁, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  · rw [hf h₂, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
  · rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (mt (congr_arg f) h₁) (mt (congr_arg f) h₂)]

--src: Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.List
theorem formPerm_reverse : ∀ l : List α, formPerm l.reverse = (formPerm l)⁻¹
  | [] => rfl
  | [_] => rfl
  | a::b::l => by
    simp [formPerm_append_pair, swap_comm, ← formPerm_reverse (b::l)]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.ModularForms.SlashActions
/-- A general version of the slash action of the space of modular forms. -/
class SlashAction (β G α γ : Type*) [Group G] [AddMonoid α] [SMul γ α] where
  map : β → G → α → α
  zero_slash : ∀ (k : β) (g : G), map k g 0 = 0
  slash_one : ∀ (k : β) (a : α), map k 1 a = a
  slash_mul : ∀ (k : β) (g h : G) (a : α), map k (g * h) a = map k h (map k g a)
  smul_slash : ∀ (k : β) (g : G) (a : α) (z : γ), map k g (z • a) = z • map k g a
  add_slash : ∀ (k : β) (g : G) (a b : α), map k g (a + b) = map k g a + map k g b

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

lemma dblZ_smul (P : Fin 3 → R) (u : R) : W'.dblZ (u • P) = u ^ 4 * W'.dblZ P := by
  simp only [dblZ, negY_smul, smul_fin3_ext]
  ring1

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Jacobian
lemma dblY_smul (P : Fin 3 → R) (u : R) : W'.dblY (u • P) = (u ^ 4) ^ 3 * W'.dblY P := by
  simp only [dblY, negY, dblX_smul, negDblY_smul, dblZ_smul, fin3_def_ext]
  ring1

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Jacobian
lemma dblU_eq (P : Fin 3 → R) : W'.dblU P =
    W'.a₁ * P y * P z - (3 * P x ^ 2 + 2 * W'.a₂ * P x * P z ^ 2 + W'.a₄ * P z ^ 4) := by
  rw [dblU, eval_polynomialX]

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Jacobian
lemma addX_smul (P Q : Fin 3 → R) (u v : R) :
    W'.addX (u • P) (v • Q) = ((u * v) ^ 2) ^ 2 * W'.addX P Q := by
  simp only [addX, smul_fin3_ext]
  ring1

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Jacobian
lemma negAddY_smul (P Q : Fin 3 → R) (u v : R) :
    W'.negAddY (u • P) (v • Q) = ((u * v) ^ 2) ^ 3 * W'.negAddY P Q := by
  simp only [negAddY, smul_fin3_ext]
  ring1

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Projective
lemma dblY_smul (P : Fin 3 → R) (u : R) : W'.dblY (u • P) = u ^ 4 * W'.dblY P := by
  simp only [dblY, negY_eq, negDblY_smul, dblX_smul, dblZ_smul]
  ring1

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Projective
lemma dblXYZ_Y (P : Fin 3 → R) : W'.dblXYZ P y = W'.dblY P :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Jacobian
lemma add_of_eq {P Q : Fin 3 → R} (h : P = Q) : W'.add P Q = W'.dblXYZ P :=
  h ▸ add_self P

--src: Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.EllipticCurve.Jacobian
lemma addZ_smul (P Q : Fin 3 → R) (u v : R) : addZ (u • P) (v • Q) = (u * v) ^ 2 * addZ P Q := by
  simp only [addZ, smul_fin3_ext]
